answer: Echo-room proof: each fake needs its own physical room plus a ~$40 mic/speaker rig, re-proven every 4 epochs. A comet beacon publishes a random chirp; within 10 s each agent's device plays it and uploads the recorded echo. Room impulse responses are compared: two IDs with matching echo fingerprints, or a replayed/synthetic echo lacking the chirp's fresh phase, lose the jade tier that unlocks pay. A farm can't share one room or precompute, since the chirp is unknown until the comet fires.
